## Objetive
Learn to train models with statcodgen
 
### Prepare data

Statcodgen provide two clases for train models, CodifierFastText and CodifierBERT.

```{python}
from statcodgen import Structured
from statcodgen import CodifierFastText
from statcodgen.codifier_bert import CodifierBERT
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
```

Train and test set must have, in this order, two colunms, code and text.
```{python}
# load and prepare data
path = Path.home()/"work"/"data"
test_data = "test_norwaydata_2026-01-13.parquet"
train_data = "train_norwaydata_2026-01-13.parquet"
structure_data = "NACErev21_structure.xlsx"

nace_stru_df = pd.read_excel(
    path/structure_data,
    dtype=str
)
train_df = pd.read_parquet(
    path/train_data
)
test_df = pd.read_parquet(
    path/test_data
)

train_df = train_df[
    ["nace_21_code", "company_activity"]
]
test_df = test_df[
    ["nace_21_code", "company_activity"]
]
train_df["nace_21_code"] = train_df["nace_21_code"].apply(
    lambda c: c.replace(".", "")
)
test_df["nace_21_code"] = test_df["nace_21_code"].apply(
    lambda c: c.replace(".", "")
)
```

## Prepare stucutre a text prepoceser
```{python}
# Prepare strucuture instance
class StruturedNACE(Structured):
    def get_level(self, c):
        c = c.replace(".", "")
        return len(c)-1

struc_nace = StruturedNACE(
    structure_df=nace_stru_df,
    names_l=[
        "Section", "Division", "Group", "Class"
    ]
)
# defining basic preproceser
def preprocess_text(t):
    if pd.isna(t):
        t = ""
    return t.lower()
```
## Train model
```{python}
ft_trainer = CodifierFastText(
    root_path=path,
    structure_instance=struc_nace,
    train_df=train_df,
    test_df=test_df,
    preprocess=preprocess_text
)

ft_trainer.train()
```
## Evaluate model
```{python}
eval_dict = ft_trainer.evaluate(
    get_curve =False
)
```
